title: All delete methods not working nor is new folder created
creator: pyxis
content:
Reinstall of Thunderbird after a few years easy with all my old (sub) folders captured from service provider. However, neither delete folder (via any option) nor create folder is acted upon. Also ignored is attempt to rename a folder. Inbox contains over 23 000 messages but none after 5 December 2025. Deleting hundreds permanently on provider has no effect on Thunderbird. Some folders are empty but but are labelled as containing hundreds of messages.

Trying to send a message results in error, 'Could not detect login form.' But I am logged in.

Any pointers to unclogging system gratefully received. Chris Oldman
